title: WPT tokenizer lock (data/recipes/tokenizers/<name>.lock.json), written by the build: the frozen vocabulary of one recipe version

recipe.description: the tokenizer recipe as it was when the vocabulary was trained, version included

documents_sha256.description: the sha256 of the object, in the store that holds the vocabulary, that lists every document it was trained on: one line each, the JSON array of the document id and the sha256 of its Markdown, sorted by the line's bytes

document_count.description: the number of lines of that list

left_out.description: the sources left out of the build that trained the vocabulary, each with the kind of its error; absent when none was
